newsitem.title: USA: IMM currencies close mostly lower, Swiss francs off.
newsitem.headline: IMM currencies close mostly lower, Swiss francs off.

text.p: Sept 13 - IMM currency futures closed mostly lower, with Swiss francs leading declines. Dec Swiss francs fell below two-mos low at $0.8136. Dec marks posted modest losses, as cash mark/Swiss franc strengthened. Strong rally in U.S. bonds and U.S. stocks kept most currencies on defensive. Can dollars firm.
